description: One data row of exec/groups_month.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8. Retired names: schema_version 2.0 renamed a column (group_id is now cell_kind).

active_days.description: Sum of the cell's persons' active days.

active_persons.description: Persons with at least one active day; withheld when it would expose a few people.

cell_id.description: Id of the grid cell: org:, unit:<unit_id> or attr:<attribute>=<value>|...

cell_key.description: Cell id without its kind prefix.

cell_kind.description: Kind of grid cell: org, unit or attr.

cost_ref.description: Sum of cost_ref over the cell's persons.

depth.description: Depth of the cell in the grid: 0 for the organisation, 1 for a root unit.

hidden.description: True when a privacy rule withheld at least one covered value of the row; empty values then mean withheld.

is_final.description: True when the provider will no longer revise the figure.

p50_cost_ref.description: Median cost_ref per person in the cell (nearest rank).

p75_cost_ref.description: 75th percentile of cost_ref per person in the cell.

p90_cost_ref.description: 90th percentile of cost_ref per person in the cell.

p99_cost_ref.description: 99th percentile of cost_ref per person in the cell.

parent_cell_id.description: cell_id of the parent cell; empty for the organisation cell.

persons.description: Number of attributed persons in the cell.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

top_decile_share.description: Share of the organisation's cost_ref spent by its top tenth of persons; organisation cell only.

title: gold-dataset-exec-groups_month
x-cost-column-rule: A cell's `cost_ref` already sums its persons, and cells overlap: a unit cell contains its sub-unit cells. Sum the cells of one `cell_kind` at one `depth`, never across depths.
x-grain: One row per month and grid cell.
